sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A perennial of Europe and western Asia, growing in dry grassland, often on calcareous soils. Its upright stems are usually 30–60 cm tall, sometimes about 1 m.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and roots
sections.text: The basal rosette has deeply divided leaves with narrow leaflets. In early summer, branched stems carry panicles of small cream to white flowers. The roots have tuberous swellings.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: The sources consulted do not establish reliable food use.
